import html # Predefined template for formatting blog posts. # Placeholders are `{title}` and `{body}` which will be replaced with sanitized values. BLOG_FORMAT = "

{title}

\n

{body}

" def display_blog_entry(heading: str, content: str) -> str: """ Return a sanitized and formatted blog entry ready for safe display. Parameters ---------- heading : str The title of the blog post. content : str The main body text of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and formatted HTML of the blog post. Raises ------ TypeError If either `heading` or `content` is not a string. """ if not isinstance(heading, str): raise TypeError(f"Expected `heading` to be a string, got {type(heading).__name__}") if not isinstance(content, str): raise TypeError(f"Expected `content` to be a string, got {type(content).__name__}") # Escape any HTML characters to prevent XSS attacks. safe_title = html.escape(heading, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(content, quote=True) # Format the sanitized values into the template. formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_post
